_doc: Known-defect ledger (Spec DC-000). Each entry keeps the defective observation and why it is wrong; it never asserts a corrected value or a root cause that has not been established.

observed.resolution: hourly means of five-minute statistics; counters as recorded deltas

defects.why_wrong: Reconstructed site exchange does not reconcile with the physical grid meter (import +38.839 kWh, export +19.112 kWh).
defects.intended: Site exchange reconstructed for scoring reconciles with the declared meter within a declared uncertainty budget, or scoring is visibly marked unreliable for that reason.
defects.root_cause: unresolved (hypothesis: AC EV charging already inside house load is added again via vehicle pack power)
